title: Chicago Curling Club
specs: Facility has four sheets of ice, locker rooms, kitchen, dining, and social/viewing area
Bonspiels include teams from Midwest US and Canada
Participants must be at least 18 years of age for Learn 2 Curl
Shoes worn on ice must have clean soles without gravel or grass
Bonspiels accommodate 16 to 40 teams depending on event
Learn 2 Curl classes have a maximum of 32 people
includes: All meals, soda, beer on tap, & house wine included in Chicago Open Bonspiel price
3 game guarantee, dinner Friday, all meals Saturday, breakfast & lunch Sunday, draft beer, wine, soda, snacks, raffle included in 40th Mixed Bonspiel
gap: Duration and price not stated for some bonspiels
blurb: The Chicago Curling Club has four sheets of ice and hosts bonspiels (curling tournaments) for various groups including men, women, mixed, and open teams. They offer Learn 2 Curl sessions where participants learn curling basics and play a game. The club also hosts corporate events and member-only bonspiels.
extraNote: Learn2Curl ticket purchases are non-refundable · Registrations for Chicago Open Bonspiel are time-stamped and accepted by payment order; local teams selected by random drawing
